The '''Tromper Crags mineral mine''' was a mineral mine located underneath the western mountains of the [[Highmount Ridge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] controlled the mine, along with the rest of the neighboring [[Tromper Crags Geothermal Plant]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tromper Crags mineral mine appears as part of the Highmount Ridge on Hoth in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
